message.content:
This editorial illustration features a stylized portrait of a man from the chest up against a black background. He has a rounded face, large ears, short-cropped hair, and a neutral expression. He wears a dark, collared uniform jacket with two breast pockets. His right hand is raised, holding a small, transparent plastic bag filled with white powder. Below his shoulders, several yellow stars and dark, badge-shaped icons with red borders appear to be floating or falling around him.

The top of the image features the word "TEMPO" in large, red, serif letters. Above this, white text on black and red backgrounds reads "Wawancara Eksklusif Ferdy Sambo H.84" and "Sirop Obat Penyebab Gagal Ginjal Anak. H.30". Below the title, smaller red text says "ENAK DIBACA DAN". A barcode, QR code, and publication details including "24-30 OKTOBER 2022" and "RP 50.000" are in the upper right. Large white text on the left reads "NARKOTIK DI KANTONG JENDERAL," followed by a paragraph mentioning "Inspektur Jenderal Teddy Minahasa" and "Kapolda Jawa Timur." Small yellow-and-red patches with the word "PELOPOR" are visible at the bottom.
